findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: brightpearl_get_contacts · Private data: brightpearl_get_order_notes, brightpearl_add_order_note, brightpearl_search_goods_out_notes, brightpearl_search_goods_in_notes, brightpearl_search_contacts, brightpearl_get_contacts, brightpearl_add_contact_note · Public sink: brightpearl_add_order_note, brightpearl_add_contact_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: brightpearl_get_contacts · Private data: brightpearl_get_order_notes, brightpearl_add_order_note, brightpearl_search_goods_out_notes, brightpearl_search_goods_in_notes, brightpearl_search_contacts, brightpearl_get_contacts, brightpearl_add_contact_note · Public sink: brightpearl_add_order_note, brightpearl_add_contact_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
